# fossa_oidc_trust_relationship (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audiences` (List of String) Array of valid audiences for this trust relationship
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the OIDC Provider to use for this trust relationship
- `required_claims` (Attributes List) Array of claim objects. Must contain at least one object with claim: "sub".
Additional objects with other claims are optional. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--required_claims))
- `scope` (String) The scope level of the trust relationship
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user to associate with this trust relationship

### Optional

- `scope_id` (Number) The ID of the team

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the trust relationship was created
- `email` (String) The email of the service account associated with this trust relationship (`null` if the account has no email)
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the OIDC Trust Relationship
- `issuer` (String) The issuer URL of the OIDC Provider
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this trust relationship belongs to
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team. `null` for organization-scoped trust relationships (only team-scoped relationships have a team name).
- `updated_at` (String) When the trust relationship was last updated
- `username` (String) The username of the service account associated with this trust relationship

<a id="nestedatt--required_claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `required_claims`

Required:

- `claim` (String) The claim type identifier
- `value` (String) The claim value

Optional:

- `has_wildcards` (Boolean) Whether this claim supports wildcard matching. Defaults to false.
If true, then the following characters in `value` are treated as special characters:
- `?` matches exactly one character
- `*` matches zero or more characters
- `\` escapes the following character
